name: WAGONUV1-1-the-cart-laid-as-drawn
note: The report itself: the cart's pictures laid planar on its faces as Mac drew them, tipped 10.1 degrees on the axle - borne level, its sideboards run 10 degrees off the rail and its stakes lean.

name: WAGONUV1-2-the-wheels-laid-level-too
note: The wheels handed to the level law: their faces lose their own hub (wheelUv's pivot and radius) and the picture slides off the wheel.

name: WAGONUV1-3-the-level-turned-the-wrong-way
note: fromLevel's turn instead of its undoing: the boards twice as far off the rail as before the fix.

name: WAGONUV1-4-the-side-laid-from-the-axle-again
old: return planarUv([p[0], p[1], p[2] - mid], n, [tile, 1])[0] + 0.5 + CARAVAN_SIDE_WINDOW_U;
note: The report itself: planarUv's run from the rear axle - the front window 0.3 m from the body's front end, the rear one 1.7 m from its rear.

name: WAGONUV1-5-the-half-texel-dropped
note: The picture's middle taken for the window's: the window is 21 texels, 22 to 42, its middle half a texel past 32 - each window 2.3 cm off, the two sides opposite ways.

name: WAGONUV1-6-the-room-laid-from-the-axle
note: The side moved and the room did not: its windows' glass no longer the side's, so from inside a window looks onto the boards and from outside onto the room's wall.

name: WAGONUV1-7-the-window-back-under-the-cornice
old: y0: sideRow((CARAVAN_SKIRT_Y + CARAVAN_CORNICE_Y + 0.84) / 2), y1: sideRow((CARAVAN_SKIRT_Y + CARAVAN_CORNICE_Y - 0.84) / 2), x0: 22, x1: 42,
note: WAGONS1's rows: six under the cornice, thirteen over the skirt.
